description: Source code implementing platform-specific cache drop and sync commands, including Windows, Linux, and macOS, with functions for privilege management and system calls.

methods.name: cmd_sync
methods.description: Performs system-specific cache synchronization, e.g., 'sync' command on Unix-like systems or Windows-specific implementation.

methods.name: cmd_dropcaches
methods.description: Drops system caches using platform-specific commands or APIs, e.g., echo 3 to /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches on Linux, or 'purge' on macOS.
